repos_data.description: A lightweight macOS selection translator built with pure Swift 6, featuring on-device Apple Translate for privacy, only 5MB install size and stable ~50MB memory usage. 一款轻量级 macOS 划词翻译工具，纯 Swift 6 开发，设备端 Apple 翻译保护隐私，安装体积仅 5MB，后台运行内存稳定约 50MB
Feature-packed native macOS screenshot & recording tool: annotate, auto-redact PII, record GIFs, OCR + translate, scroll capture, beautify, and more. No Electron, no subscription.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
Open-source MCP server for FreezeText — OCR anything on your Mac screen from Claude/Cursor. Screen capture, region OCR, image OCR, searchable history.

一个简洁优雅的词典翻译 macOS App。开箱即用，支持离线 OCR 识别，支持有道词典，🍎 苹果系统词典，🍎 苹果系统翻译，OpenAI，Gemini，DeepL，Google，Bing，腾讯，百度，阿里，小牛，彩云和火山翻译。A concise and elegant Dictionary and Translator macOS App for looking up words and translating text.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.
Copy any text on your screen, stop retyping.
⌨️ Open-source keyboard layout text converter for macOS — fix text typed in wrong layout. Double-Shift hotkey, 5 layouts, greedy line detection, menu bar app.
An open-source native macOS screenshot and screen recording app. A CleanShot X alternative.
Menu bar app that types your script into any app - one block per hotkey press, as real keystrokes at a human pace. For demos, screencasts, and presentations.
🚀 BarTranslate, a handy (free) menu bar translator widget for macOS.
Type an app name, press Enter, all its windows come to you. Per-app window control, app launcher, and workspace management for macOS.

repo_meta_data.description: Screen translation app for macOS — select any area, get instant translation. On-device by default with Apple Vision OCR + Apple Translation.
